pre_scoring_audit_findings.finding: Original 308 generated HelixBank queries have direct lexical coupling to intent-derived document wording.
pre_scoring_audit_findings.repair: Retain them as contract/edge-case evidence; use natural BANKING77 fit-train utterances as the primary retrieval-quality benchmark.

pre_scoring_audit_findings.finding: Initial balanced allocation 20 development + 10 confirmatory per intent was infeasible because the smallest fit_train intent had 27 rows.
pre_scoring_audit_findings.repair: Reduce to 18 development + 8 confirmatory per intent before any score or hash freeze.

pre_scoring_audit_findings.finding: Workflow materializer pipeline lacked pipefail and could mislabel a failed Python command as a successful step when piped through tee.
pre_scoring_audit_findings.repair: Enable set -o pipefail before scientific materialization pipelines.

decision: Benchmark bytes and sealed confirmatory hashes are frozen. B0 development scoring may begin only after the repository verifies the frozen manifest reproducibly and the release quality gate passes.
